definitions.explanation: The ability to read and understand written text.

examples.japanese: {読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧。
{読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I scored high on the reading comprehension test.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。

notes:
{読解力|どっかいりょく} refers to the ability to understand written texts. It is a key skill tested in language exams and important for academic success.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ (to improve reading comprehension)
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (reading comprehension test)
- {読解力|どっかいりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}→向上：02731_koujou⟧ (improvement in reading ability)
